fields.name: trigger
fields.type: jsonb AutomationTrigger: event (event type and optional filter), schedule (five-field cron, UTC), or metric (query, value_column, op, threshold, for_minutes, every_minutes)

fields.name: steps
fields.type: jsonb AutomationStep[]: award_points, notify, send_message, apply_promotion, create_task, webhook; each with id, optional when, on_error stop or continue

states: enabled <-> disabled (an agent's change, and enabling a webhook step, are held for approval)
relations: owner -> principal whose grants every step is checked against
steps name Promotion, Group, Segment and Content references
entities.retention: Revisions kept by the change log.

strata.how: Automation as an automation-def (id, label, run-as, optional run-key, start, steps as a map of automation-step-def) with one trigger-def per subscribed event (on trigger-event, optional condition, automation, paused). activate-workflow moves a draft to active. Plinth event triggers map to record-created, record-updated, record-deleted, ledger-posted or declared-event; schedule triggers map to a schedule (RRULE with TZID) through schedule-due; step kinds map to automation-step variants.
strata.note: Plinth checks each step against the owner's current grants at run time. Strata fixes the run-as roles at definition, re-checks them when the definer's authority changes, and suspends the automation when a role is lost (WFL-1529). Plinth metric triggers and per-member limits have no Strata variant.

fields.name: trigger_key
fields.notes: event:<seq>, cron:<minute>, metric:<window>, manual:<key> or retry:<run>:<n>; unique with workspace_id and automation_id

fields.name: context
fields.type: jsonb (event payload, member facts snapshot, now)

fields.name: status
fields.type: enum(queued, running, succeeded, failed, skipped, cancelled)

states: queued -> skipped (condition, limit, or loop guard at creation)
entities.retention: Not stated in the contract; no purge in the code reviewed.

strata.how: A run is a workflow run with a run-key (run-key on automation-def, one run per distinct value; SCH-1536). automation-run-summary and list-automation-runs answer the run list. Run states are running, completed, failed, cancelled, compensating, awaiting-approval, waiting and suspended. Declined and skipped outcomes are exception records (automation-exception-kind, automation-exception-reason), not runs.
strata.note: Plinth writes a skipped run when a condition is false; Strata writes no run and no exception for a false condition (D-6530). A limit skip has no Strata reason.

fields.name: type
fields.type: enum(award_points, notify, send_message, apply_promotion, create_task, webhook)

states: pending -> skipped (when false, or run cancelled)

strata.how: automation-step-summary (sequence, step, state, attempts, result, errors, approval). Each step's writes are keyed by the step key (SCH-015), so a re-run applies once. step-retry (attempts from 1 to 10, first-delay, max-delay) gives the retry schedule; the 1, 4 and 16 second waits are one configuration of it.
strata.note: Plinth's pending state with next_attempt_at is the job waiting for its retry. Strata's step key is the job's idempotency key.

fields.name: holding_since
fields.type: timestamptz (virtual; null while the condition is false)

states: not holding -> holding (condition true) -> fired (held for for_minutes, rising edge)

evidence: specifications/boundary.jsonc types trigger-event (no metric or threshold variant)
strata.note: Strata triggers react to domain events and schedules. None fires when an aggregate query crosses a threshold and stays there.

strata.how: call-webhook automation step: a signed delivery queued through the outbound gate, with a delivery log (list-webhook-deliveries shows status, attempts and state; webhook-delivery struct).
strata.note: Plinth never sends; the row is a stub. Strata does send, and the delivery outcome does not yet reach the run (WG-5489).

entities.retention: One row per consumer per workspace.

strata.how: Platform position state of the automation worker and notice queue: a notice is redelivered until its subscriber acknowledges it (receive-notices, acknowledge-notice).
strata.note: Platform internals rather than product metadata. Run keys give the exactly-once guarantee that Plinth gets from UNIQUE trigger_key.

entities.retention: One row per job per workspace.

strata.how: Schedules (define-schedule) and schedule-job: the next job of a schedule is created in the transaction that completes the previous one (SCH-003). Paused schedules create no job (SCH-005).
strata.note: Plinth catches up at most 60 missed minutes from this row. Whether Strata catches up missed fires is not confirmed in the spec read.

authz.approval: Agent enable and agent disable are held for automation:manage approval (R-AUTOMATION-ENABLE). Enabling an automation with a webhook step is held for admin:settings (R-AUTOMATION-EXTERNAL) for every principal.

preconditions: the requested state differs from the current state
effects: Automation /spec/enabled set through the change log, managed by automation.set_enabled
approval.requested when the change is held
operations.idempotency: State toggle: a repeat with the same state is refused, not replayed.
errors: CONFLICT INVALID_TRANSITION when the automation already has the requested state
operations.audit: Change log commit, or a change_approvals row when held.

strata.how: Enabling is activate-workflow (owner role only; draft to active). Disabling is a trigger's paused flag (trigger-def) or a definition change. Approval of a held change is a proposal approved by a person (approve-proposal).
strata.note: Strata gives an agent no path to activate, so an agent enable is refused rather than held for a person. Plinth holds it for a person to approve. Security-relevant (authorisation, ledger, audit or personal data).

effects: automation_runs row with trigger_key manual:<idempotency_key> and trigger type manual
steps run as service:automation on behalf of the owner
operations.idempotency: Same key returns the run already created (UNIQUE trigger key).
operations.audit: Run row and run_updated events with actor and on_behalf_of.

strata.how: start-workflow-run with an idempotency key names the same run for the same key and inputs; the starter is recorded on the run.
strata.note: Plinth runs a disabled automation on demand, with real effects. Whether Strata starts a draft, paused or suspended automation is not confirmed.

effects: new run with trigger_key retry:<run_id>:<n> that re-executes the failed and pending steps under their original step keys
errors: CONFLICT INVALID_TRANSITION when the run is not failed
operations.audit: New run row with trigger type retry and of_run.

strata.how: retry-job creates a new attempt of a failed job and leaves earlier outcomes unchanged (AGT-418). Step keys are kept per step.
strata.note: Strata retries a job, not a run. A run-level retry that re-executes the failed and pending steps of a run is not a contract in the spec read.

preconditions: the run is queued or running
effects: pending steps set to skipped; finished steps stay done
operations.idempotency: Refused once the run is not queued or running (CONFLICT).
errors: CONFLICT INVALID_TRANSITION when the run is finished

strata.how: cancel-job ends a job so that no later attempt happens; the run state cancelled exists.
strata.note: No run-level cancel contract was found in the spec read.

authz.permission: points:award on the owner's grants, row predicate applied to the target member

preconditions: the target member exists and is not disabled
points at most program manager_max_per_award (above it the step is refused LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
the owner's grant reaches the member
effects: ledger award posting with the promotion bonus (channel automation)
promotion charge when a promotion applied
notification points_awarded to the member (dedupe key run:<run>:step:<step>)

operations.audit: Ledger transaction, domain event with cause, notification row.

strata.note: The promotion bonus is computed live from member facts and promotion eligibility (promotions-core), which needs ledger and segment facts in rules. Security-relevant (authorisation, ledger, audit or personal data).

notification.created events; per-recipient preference and quiet hours decide the channels
errors: none specific; a missing permission fails the step FORBIDDEN
operations.audit: Notification rows with source event sequence.

strata.note: A group target such as group:all-staff has no single Strata target; it maps to a team or to a segment. Plinth's dedupe key per recipient is not a stated Strata behaviour.

effects: message thread of kind system, sent from service:automation on behalf of the owner

strata.note: Strata has no thread with participants and replies; a Plinth system thread has no Strata equivalent.

effects: promotion_entitlements row granted now, expiring after expires_in_days, keyed to the origin run, promotion and member

operations.audit: Entitlement row and the run's step output.

task_assigned notification to the assignee when not the owner

errors: RULE_REFUSED MEMBER_DISABLED when the assignee is missing

evidence: specifications/boundary.jsonc records rec-approval-task (approvals only; no general task)
strata.note: Strata has approval tasks for held decisions, not work items with assignee, priority, due date, status and comments.

effects: webhook_deliveries row with status recorded; nothing is sent

strata.how: call-webhook step: a signed delivery through the outbound gate, queued once per step key; the delivery job keeps the attempts and the log.
strata.note: Plinth's webhook never leaves the platform; Strata's does. The approval routing for enabling it is the gap. Security-relevant (authorisation, ledger, audit or personal data).

preconditions: event type is in the TRIGGERABLE set (20 types)
the event filter holds on the payload and the member facts
effects: automation_runs row per matching automation with trigger_key event:<seq>
a LOOP_SUSPECTED skipped run when the event's cause depth is 3 or more or the same automation caused it
errors: a refusal for one event logs a warning and does not wedge the consumer

strata.how: fire-trigger creates the jobs of the triggers subscribed to an event in the transaction that commits it (SCH-004), one per trigger whose event matches and whose condition holds; run keys make each once.
strata.note: Strata's guard is a hop count (limit 8). Plinth stops at depth 3 and also stops an automation's own events, which Strata does not do.

preconditions: the five-field cron matches the UTC minute
effects: run per matching automation with trigger_key cron:<minute ISO>

strata.how: define-schedule with an RRULE (RFC 5545) and TZID, and a schedule-due trigger.
strata.note: Plinth's day rule is OR when both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted; the RRULE mapping has to keep it. Plinth is UTC only.

authz.permission: the owner's grants when running the query (QueryEngine as owner)

preconditions: the automation is enabled and is a metric trigger
every_minutes has elapsed since the last evaluation
effects: run with trigger_key metric:<holding_since> on the rising edge after for_minutes
operations.idempotency: last_fired_key prevents a second fire in the same window.
errors: a query error skips the automation for this tick

strata.note: A metric check is a periodic evaluation of a named query with a hold time; Strata has the query and the schedule but no trigger that uses them.

preconditions: a running run has a pending step whose next_attempt_at has passed
effects: the run's remaining steps execute in order
operations.idempotency: Step keys; a retried step does not repeat its effect.
errors: retryable errors wait 1 s, then 4 s, then 16 s; a third failure fails the step

strata.how: Jobs with leases and retries under step-retry (attempts, first-delay, max-delay), each step key the job's idempotency key.
strata.note: Strata's default first delay is 10 seconds and doubles; Plinth's 1, 4, 16 is a configuration.

invariants.statement: A run is created at most once per automation and trigger key, so a re-delivered event or a repeated tick never starts a second run.

strata.how: Run keys (run-key on automation-def) give one run per distinct value.

invariants.statement: An event caused at cause depth 3 or more, or caused by the same automation, never starts a run; the skipped match is recorded as LOOP_SUSPECTED.

strata.how: Hop count limit 8 on trigger matching; no same-automation rule.

invariants.statement: Each step writes under the key run:<run_id>:step:<step_id>, so a step re-executed after a crash or a retry produces no second ledger posting, message, notification, task, entitlement or delivery.

strata.how: Each automation step has an idempotency key and a step key (SCH-015).

invariants.statement: Each step is authorised against the owner's current grants when it runs; a missing permission fails that step FORBIDDEN and it is not retried.

strata.how: run-as roles on the automation; the automation principal's authority is re-checked when the definer's authority changes and the automation is suspended (suspended-for).
strata.note: Roles fixed at definition, not per-step grant checks at run time. Equivalent for suspension, different for a grant withdrawn mid-run.

invariants.statement: When the owner principal no longer exists, the run fails UNKNOWN_REFERENCE instead of blocking the engine.

strata.how: The automation is suspended when its definer can no longer confer a role of its run-as (suspended state).

invariants.statement: A retryable step error is retried at most three attempts in all, waiting 1 s then 4 s; a third failure fails the step.

strata.how: step-retry with attempts 3, first-delay 1 s and a doubling delay.
strata.note: Strata's doubling gives 1 s then 2 s; 1 s then 4 s needs the same factor-of-four configuration, which step-retry may not express.

invariants.statement: When the automation's conditions are false the run is recorded skipped and no step executes; a step with when false is skipped and the rest run.

strata.how: Conditions are expressions on the trigger (condition) and on each step; a false condition writes no run (D-6530).
strata.note: Plinth records the skipped run; Strata records nothing for a false condition. A design choice for the Strata spec.

invariants.statement: A member gets at most max_runs_per_member_per_day runs in a virtual UTC day (counting succeeded and running) and no run within cooldown_minutes of the last succeeded run; the excess is skipped with LIMIT.

evidence: crates/kernel/src/limits.rs (kernel maximums only; no per-subject run limit)
strata.note: Strata's limits are maximums on the tenant, not per-subject run counts or cooldowns.

invariants.statement: A step with on_error stop halts the rest of the run; with continue the later steps still run; the run is failed when any step failed.

strata.how: A failed step runs the compensations of completed steps in reverse order (saga); there is no per-step continue.

invariants.statement: An agent may not enable an automation, and an agent's disable is held too; the change waits for approval by automation:manage.

strata.how: An agent cannot hold the owner role that activates a workflow, so it is refused rather than held.

invariants.statement: Enabling an automation that has a webhook step is held for admin:settings approval, for every principal.

strata.how: Activation by an owner, with a policy requiring a second approver for outbound calls.

invariants.statement: A manual run with the same idempotency key returns the same run; the run uses trigger key manual:<key>.

fundamentals.capability: A trigger that fires when a named query's value crosses a threshold and holds for a set time, once per window, on the rising edge.
fundamentals.why: Strata triggers fire on domain events and schedules (trigger-event variants). None watches a query's value. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc types trigger-event and the trigger-def.

fundamentals.capability: Evaluate a whole workflow or automation definition against a sample or recorded event with no writes, reporting per step whether it would run, why not, its effect and the permission verdict.
fundamentals.why: Strata has a dry run for an operation and a preview of pending actions (action-preview), not for a definition against an event. Checked crates/backend/src/operations.rs and specifications/boundary.jsonc types action-preview

fundamentals.capability: Per-subject limits on runs of one automation: a maximum per day and a cooldown after a success, skipping the excess with a reason.
fundamentals.why: Strata limits are tenant maximums (crates/kernel/src/limits.rs). No per-subject run count or cooldown exists. Checked the automation-exception-reason enum: no limit reason.

fundamentals.capability: Run-level control: retry a failed run re-running its failed and pending steps under their original keys, cancel a queued or running run keeping finished steps, and start a run of a paused automation on demand.
fundamentals.why: Strata controls jobs (retry-job, cancel-job) and has a run state cancelled, but no run-level retry or cancel contract. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc contracts retry-job and cancel-job.

fundamentals.capability: Rules, predicates and policies that read a ledger balance, a lifetime total or a tier derived from them.
fundamentals.why: The Strata expression language (crates/model-core/src/types.rs Expr) has no balance function; the showcase README gap 3 records the same. D-6545 decided it; not landed in the code read.
neededBy: M9.tier.changed (consumed by people and segments widgets)

fundamentals.capability: Count or sum records or ledger entries over a trailing window (orders in 90 days, points earned in 30 days, runs in 7 days), usable in facts and predicates.
fundamentals.why: Aggregates exist for queries (crates/kernel/src/aggregates.rs) but not as predicate facts over a trailing window. Showcase README gap 11 records the same.

fundamentals.capability: An expression or policy tests whether a subject is in a named segment (in_segment).
fundamentals.why: The Expr variants checked have no segment membership test; segments are read as stored membership lists (list-segment-members). Checked crates/model-core/src/types.rs Expr and specifications/boundary.jsonc contracts list-segment-members

fundamentals.capability: Groups as organisation units with managers, a type, open posting and artwork, whose membership can be read by rules, lists and audiences.
fundamentals.why: Strata has tenant teams (tenant-team, add-team-member, remove-team-member) and roles, but a team has no managers, type, open posting or artwork, and its membership is not an expression. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc types tenant-team

fundamentals.capability: Month, week and day grids that place timed entries from several types, with a roving keyboard cursor.
fundamentals.why: Strata screens and views have fixed sections, not time-positioned grids. Showcase README gap 5 (fixed sections) records the same limit. Checked crates/kernel/src/ui.rs.

fundamentals.capability: One ordered result drawn from rows of several object types, with a filter per type.
fundamentals.why: Strata queries read one object type (query-plan over a QueryDef). Checked crates/kernel/src/query_plan.rs and the QueryDef struct in crates/model-core/src/types.rs.

fundamentals.capability: List the occurrence times of a recurrence rule within a range, with a bound on the count.
fundamentals.why: Strata schedules expose the next due time only (schedule-summary next-due). Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc types schedule-summary and crates/backend/src/worker/recurrence.rs.

fundamentals.capability: The outcome of an outbound webhook delivery (response status, attempts, final state) recorded back on the run step that caused it.
fundamentals.why: The outbound delivery keeps its own log (crates/backend/src/outbound) and does not write back to the workflow run. Checked crates/backend/src/worker/steps.rs:1067 and the webhook-delivery type.

fundamentals.capability: Work items with an assignee, priority, due date, status, comments and history, which automations create and triggers observe.
fundamentals.why: Strata has approval tasks (rec-approval-task) for held decisions, not general work items. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc records.

fundamentals.capability: A product's records naming records owned by another product (panels, products, badges, promotions).
fundamentals.why: A product names only its own and platform entities (showcase README gap 1). Checked crates/spec-compiler references in the showcase README.

fundamentals.capability: Per-record versions and diffs, and a published revision served while a later draft is edited (effective dating).
fundamentals.why: The change log holds revisions, but the spec read has no record-level version read, diff or effective-dated serving. Checked crates/kernel/src/transition.rs and specifications/boundary.jsonc contracts show-review-diff

fundamentals.capability: Named image assets and file domains, referenced by records (hero images, group artwork).
fundamentals.why: Strata's file store exists; named assets and file domains per product are not in the spec read. Checked crates/backend/src/files.

fundamentals.capability: Keyboard operation of grids, rows and editors: arrow keys, Home, End, Page keys, Enter and Space to activate, Ctrl or Cmd plus S to save.
fundamentals.why: Strata's generated screens have no per-widget keyboard gesture model in the spec read. Checked the web widget sources.

fundamentals.capability: Reusable composite controls: a rule builder with live preview, a step list with per-step forms, a block editor with a diff.
fundamentals.why: Strata generated forms and screens do not compose these controls. Checked the widget sources for the builders.

fundamentals.capability: A widget with internal views (list and reader, editor and preview) and a shared selection bus between widgets on one page.
fundamentals.why: Strata screens are single views; no in-widget view switching or bus was found in the spec read.

fundamentals.capability: Per-row and per-field visibility across lists and timelines: private fields to self and privileged readers, activity filtered by type and viewer, engagement readable by owner only.
fundamentals.why: Field read rules hide fields (D-6586), but per-viewer filtering of lists and event timelines by type and row scope is not in the spec read. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc (search: rules)

fundamentals.capability: Message threads with participants, replies and read state, sent by an automation on behalf of an owner.
fundamentals.why: Strata has one-way notices and mail (send-mail, create-notice), with no thread or reply. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc types send-message-step

fundamentals.capability: Agent-initiated configuration changes that wait for a named human approver (enabling an automation, enabling a webhook, awards above a limit), rather than being refused.
fundamentals.why: Strata gives agents no path to activate workflows (owner role), so the only outcome is a refusal. Proposals exist (approve-proposal) but are not wired to activation. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc contracts activate-workflow and approve-proposal.

fundamentals.capability: Refuse to start a trigger for an event that the same automation's own writes caused, in addition to a depth limit.
fundamentals.why: Strata's guard is a hop count (HOP_LIMIT 8), with no same-automation rule. Checked crates/kernel/src/triggers.rs:59 and :147.

fundamentals.capability: Continue a run with later steps after a failed step, with the run failed if any step failed (on_error continue).
fundamentals.why: Strata's failed step runs compensations of completed steps (saga); there is no per-step continue. Checked crates/backend/src/worker/saga.rs.

fundamentals.capability: Readers of a domain event defined per record (its creator, or a member named on it), not only by role.
fundamentals.why: event-kind-decl readers are roles only (specifications/boundary.jsonc types event-kind-decl). Checked that no per-record reader is declared.

fundamentals.capability: An approval decided by principals named on the record (its reviewers), with the author excluded.
fundamentals.why: Strata's approval step names roles (automation-approval roles), not the principals on a record. Checked specifications/boundary.jsonc types automation-approval
